Structural Rebar · Revit Add-in

Legs Generator

Detail reinforcement legs where concrete edges change.

Generate hook legs for top or bottom rebar layers at boundaries, openings, and drop panels while accounting for local thickness and specified cover.

Request Demo on WhatsApp Watch Demo
Key features

Handle the edges and openings that slow down detailing

Drop panels and openings interrupt otherwise repetitive reinforcement. Use the host geometry to guide the generated legs, then review transitions and cover against the design detail.

  • 01

    Automates placing of structural hook legs for both top and bottom reinforcement layers

  • 02

    Smart edge detection

    only draws legs at concrete boundaries, openings, and drop panels

  • 03

    Intelligent variable thickness calculation

    adjusts hook lengths automatically for varying floor thicknesses (e.g. 500mm to 200mm drops)

  • 04

    Detail legs for slabs, raft foundations, isolated footings, and structural beams.

  • 05

    Use the specified concrete cover when determining the bend geometry.

  • 06

    Review generated legs at changes in thickness, around openings, and at perimeter transitions.
